description: The ansible.builtin.script module takes the script name followed by a list of space-delimited arguments.

parameters.name: chdir
parameters.description: Change into this directory on the remote node before running the script.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Path to the local script to run followed by optional arguments.

parameters.name: creates
parameters.description: A filename on the remote node, when it already exists, this step will not be run.

parameters.name: decrypt
parameters.description: This option controls the auto-decryption of source files using vault. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: Name or path of an executable to invoke the script with.

parameters.name: free_form
parameters.description: Path to the local script file followed by optional arguments.

parameters.name: removes
parameters.description: A filename on the remote node, when it does not exist, this step will not be run.

examples:
- name: Run a script with arguments (free form)
  ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/script.sh --some-argument 1234

- name: Run a script with arguments (using 'cmd' parameter)
  ansible.builtin.script:
    cmd: /some/local/script.sh --some-argument 1234

- name: Run a script only if file.txt does not exist on the remote node
  ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/create_file.sh --some-argument 1234
  args:
    creates: /the/created/file.txt

- name: Run a script only if file.txt exists on the remote node
  ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/remove_file.sh --some-argument 1234
  args:
    removes: /the/removed/file.txt

- name: Run a script using an executable in a non-system path
  ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/script
  args:
    executable: /some/remote/executable

- name: Run a script using an executable in a system path
  ansible.builtin.script: /some/local/script.py
  args:
    executable: python3

- name: Run a Powershell script on a Windows host
  script: subdirectories/under/path/with/your/playbook/script.ps1
